reviews.text: Untappd are clearly trying to make the app as non-user friendly as possible unless you have an insider subscription.  Trying to navigate through YOUR OWN past check-ins is now almost impossible unless you’re willing to pay £5/$5 per month.  Absolute sell outs.

reviews.title: New sorting methods fail.
reviews.text: Parts of the new sorting are okay, but why did you remove the previous sorting method of crisp, hoppy, malty, sour, barrel aged, etc? Now I have to wade through mostly beers I won’t like to see if a venue has something interesting for me. Please restore that as a sorting option!

reviews.title: Ensh*ttification arrives on Untappd
reviews.text:
The UI is absolutely awful for anyone with eyes. It’s like an artists’ impression of an app interface.

There was a new T&C / privacy policy and setup preferences so I presume this new version is actually a disguised data mining project.

reviews.title: Previously loved this app, now it’s garbage
reviews.text:
I get you’re trying to make money, but changing the app to just be advertising makes it stupid and useless. I’ve rated over 1200 beers over the years and it used to be such a useful tool for enjoying quality beers and connecting with beer friends. You’ve hidden everything that made this app magic. 

The new UI is terrible and makes me not want to use the app. Please hide that “discover ads” page to another tab and make the purpose for the app more accessible again. 

Disappointed.

reviews.title: Complete Overhaul, Character Missing
reviews.text: I've used Untappd for two years, and I enjoyed checking in my beers. This update changed too much. How about launching a new app instead of rebuilding the good thing? The layout is almost unrecognizable, and the learning curve is huge. The app has lost the character that made it feel like a community. It used to feel like a safe place where I could share my story with my friends and check in on them too. Now it feels like a pretty looking stranger. Please restore the missing data, and consider a classic layout option so long-time users aren't left behind.

reviews.title: New App = bad
reviews.text: The new app is extremely cumbersome and feels way more like a website than a polished app. The previous version was nice – yes it had ads and they were very annoying. However, this new version feels way more like a marketing app now instead of an app where I can go and enjoy reading and finding new beers and breweries. I’m very glad I did not pay for a year subscription, especially if this is what you get out of it. Also, please get rid of all the THC and soda rating option options. I drink beer and that’s what on top should be for.

reviews.title: Broke what didn’t need fixing

Been on this app since the beginning and the ease of use kept me coming back. Now I can barely read the fonts. Things that used to intuitively located are impossible to find. There was ZERO reason to change this app. You’ve gone and done ruined it. You broke what didn’t need fixing. 👎🏻

reviews.title: New update is terrible
reviews.text:
I don’t know who they hired to design the new update, but I would have them evaluated.

For one thing the search bar is grey, and the text is some kind of blue. I don’t know. I literally cannot read what I’m typing. Evidently readability and contrast are overrated.

Then there is the new review interface. 

What used to be nicely in line in a clean interface is now hard aligned left, with poorly formatted “tiles” to pick from, and a really half-baked feel.

My 11 year old designs better apps with AI…
